mapper.select: SELECT channel_id, pricing_version, synced_at FROM upstream_price_snapshot WHERE channel_id = #{channelId}
SELECT channel_id, upstream_model, quota_type, model_price, group_ratio, synced_at FROM upstream_price WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} ORDER BY upstream_model
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO upstream_price_snapshot (channel_id, pricing_version, synced_at) VALUES (#{channelId}, #{version}, #{syncedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pricing_version = VALUES(pricing_version), synced_at = VALUES(synced_at)

INSERT INTO upstream_price (channel_id, upstream_model, quota_type, model_price, group_ratio, synced_at) VALUES (#{channelId}, #{upstreamModel}, #{quotaType}, #{modelPrice}, #{groupRatio}, #{syncedAt})
